Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good
- The change touches one test file. No product code changes.
- The helper `stock_pane_delete` scopes the Delete lookup to the Properties pane. It reuses the pane lookup that `setups_declutter.rs` already uses on main: find the dock leaf that holds `Tab::Properties`, then filter the nodes by rect center.
- The helper asserts that exactly one Delete node exists in the pane. No node is picked by index.
- No assertion is removed. No AccessKit label changes. No snapshot PNG changes.

## Where and what I ran
I built locally on Windows, in a fresh worktree of `origin/main` (`4b7a6b1e8`) with its own `target/`. The PR head `a3774b8c0` contains main's tip, so the trial merge with `origin/main` reports "Already up to date": the merged tree equals the head tree. Tests ran with CWD `crates/ui`, in debug, with `-j 4`.

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| main, `stock_fit` filter in the `camcraft-ui` lib test binary | 5 passed, 1 failed |
| The failure on main | `stock_fit_controls_follow_the_selected_shape`: the `get_by_label("Delete")` lookup finds two nodes — the ribbon button and the Stock page button |
| main, full `camcraft-ui` lib test binary | 932 passed, 1 failed, 6 ignored. The only failing test is the named one |
| PR head, `stock_fit` filter | 6 passed, 0 failed |
| PR head, full `camcraft-ui` lib test binary | 933 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored |

Clippy: not run in this review. The author reports it clean, and the changed file compiles in the runs above.

## Requested before merge
- None.

## Notes (not blocking)
- The new file is committed with CRLF line endings; main holds the file with LF. Ignoring whitespace, the real diff is 17 added lines and 1 changed line. Main already holds six other CRLF Rust files, so this changes nothing in the build. A later cleanup should re-save the file with LF endings.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
